WITH qualifying_drivers AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id, d.XCL_038 AS forename, d.XCL_039 AS surname, d.XCL_040 AS date_of_birth
    FROM drivers d
    WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1971' AND '1985'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM lapTimes lt
          WHERE lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
            AND lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
            AND lt.XCL_048 < 120000
      )
),
youngest AS (
    SELECT driver_id, forename, surname, date_of_birth
    FROM qualifying_drivers
    ORDER BY date_of_birth DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
fastest_lap AS (
    SELECT lt.XCL_043 AS race_id
    FROM lapTimes lt
    WHERE lt.XCL_044 = (SELECT driver_id FROM youngest)
      AND lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT y.forename, y.surname, y.date_of_birth, r.XCL_069 AS race_name
FROM youngest y
CROSS JOIN fastest_lap fl
JOIN races r ON fl.race_id = r.XCL_065;
